title: Contract Terms Schedule for Continuum Backup & Recovery — Notice, Renewal and Early Termination Figures
content:
Schedule of the contract figures that apply to each Continuum Backup & Recovery tier at the end of a term or on early termination.

| Tier | Notice period (calendar days) | Automatic renewal term (months) | Maximum rate increase at renewal | Early termination fee, percent of committed monthly fees remaining |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Continuum Backup Basic | 30 | 1 | 7 percent | 0 percent |
| Continuum Backup Standard | 30 | 1 | 7 percent | 0 percent |
| Continuum Backup Plus | 60 | 12 | 5 percent | 75 percent |
| Continuum BDR | 60 | 12 | 5 percent | 75 percent |
| Continuum DRaaS | 90 | 12 | 5 percent | 80 percent |
| Continuum DRaaS Premier | 90 | 12 | 4 percent | 80 percent |

## Definitions used in this schedule

**Notice period.** The calendar days of signed notice before term end for non-renewal, and the minimum notice for early termination. The same figure serves both purposes on every tier.

**Automatic renewal term.** The length, in months, of each automatic renewal term.

**Maximum rate increase at renewal.** The maximum rate increase at renewal, in percent.

**Early termination fee percentage.** The early termination fee as a percent of committed monthly fees remaining.

## Notes

- On Continuum Backup Basic and Continuum Backup Standard each automatic renewal runs for one month, and the early termination fee percentage is 0 percent.
- On the four higher tiers each automatic renewal runs for twelve months.
